purpose: Text-conditioning pilot pair: v8 recipe unchanged except the frozen text encoder (google-t5/t5-small). Motivated by the CFG sweep on the v8 100k checkpoint: prompt-motion alignment rises with CFG (speed pearson .24->.30) but stays weak, implicating the conditioning pathway rather than the frozen VAE. Matched fresh 10k cosine runs (2k is too short for alignment signal; the frozen h8 model cannot show alignment at all because its motion is collapsed). Verdict metric: prompt-motion alignment pearson and prompt/noise L1 ratio at 10k, n=64, primary CFG 2 sampler. Single seed per arm.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Single-seed combined-treatment run; attribution of any gain to individual components rests on the matched 2k pilots, not on this run.

matched_control: the paired t5-small arm of this declaration
